text: In resolution, resolving the complementary literals of two clauses so as to derive the ___ clause (□) constitutes a refutation, showing the clause set is unsatisfiable.
explanation: Deriving the empty clause □ (a clause with no literals, representing a contradiction) is a resolution refutation and proves the original clause set unsatisfiable. Resolution is refutation-complete: the empty clause is derivable iff the set is unsatisfiable.
